post.title: $23.3 trillion of US money, and only 10.6% is cash
post.ig:
In Aug 2026, Americans had $23.3 trillion in money (M2). Only 10.6% was cash.

Money does three jobs: medium of exchange, unit of account, store of value.
The dollar isn't backed by gold: Americans turned in most gold coins in 1933, and the US stopped swapping dollars for gold with other governments in 1971.
M2 dipped to $20.7T at end-2023 and reached $23.3T in Aug 2026; cash was $2.5T of it.

Sources: Federal Reserve H.6 (Sept 2026); FRED; Federal Reserve History.
